question: Seven boxes E, F, G, H, I, J and K are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept between F and J. Neither G nor I is kept at the top. Only H is kept between G and I. K is kept immediately below J. Only one box is kept above F. How many boxes are kept between H and K?
